day2_broadcast_1.text: *The bell for fourth period rang. Lunchtime. Students started getting up — then, *crackle*. Static blasted from the speakers.*

day2_broadcast_2.text: *Low syllables broke through the static. Maybe numbers, maybe names. Only the sound of a hand brushing close to the mic came through clearly.*

day2_broadcast_3.text: *Students looked up. Staring at the speaker.*

day2_broadcast_3a.text: *...Two seconds. Three. It abruptly cut out. Then, Ms. Eunsu's voice came through, crystal clear.*

day2_broadcast_4.text: It's lunchtime. Students, please proceed in an orderly manner.

day2_broadcast_5.text:
*Dust beneath the speaker trembled once.

The students around me are packing their bags like nothing happened. Someone picked up the joke they had been telling a moment ago.*

day2_broadcast_6.text: *I turned around. Seolhwa was looking at me, lips pressed tightly together.*

day2_broadcast_7.text: *Seolhwa's fingers tapped the edge of the desk three times. The same rhythm as the broadcast cutting out.*

choices: Go to the library to see Yuna

day2_lunch_sea_1.text: *Today's lunch box. Even more elaborate than yesterday. Chicken cutlet, flower-shaped carrots, mini kimbap.*

day2_lunch_sea_2.text: ...How early did you get up to make all this?

day2_lunch_sea_3.text: If someone eats it, there's less left over.

day2_lunch_sea_5.text: My mom taught me. We cooked together since elementary school.

day2_lunch_sea_6.text: Do you still cook together? I wondered if you learned to arrange it so neatly together too. I'd probably put everything in the same compartment.

day2_lunch_sea_8.text: *Sea trails off, picking up a piece of kimbap with her chopsticks.*

day2_lunch_sea_9.text: One compartment in my lunch box is always empty. Today, I just filled it.

day2_lunch_sea_11.text: It's fine. Better than letting it go to waste.

day2_lunch_sea_12.text:
*Sea puts a mini kimbap in my lunchbox. An extra little fork is clipped inside the lid.*

You gave me some again. Sorry, it feels like I'm eating your share too. I'll take this. You eat some too.

day2_lunch_sea_13.text: {name}, what are you doing this weekend?

day2_lunch_sea_14.text: Nothing really. I don't know the neighborhood yet. Even if I go out on a day off, I wouldn't know where to start. What about you?

day2_lunch_sea_15.text: Then do you want to go downtown on Saturday? Let's go to a cafe. There's a great croffle place.

day2_lunch_sea_19.text: No. You just answered so quickly.

day2_lunch_sea_20.text:
*Sea lowers her head as if concentrating on her lunch, then hands me one earbud. The track is already just before the chorus.*

Is this the band you mentioned? I thought we'd listen from the beginning.

day2_lunch_sea_21.text: This is the band I mentioned earlier. I listen to this song the most.

day2_lunch_sea_22.text:
*A line of lyrics appeared on the lock screen. 'Before the night erases the name...' Sea turned the screen face down.*

Wait, show me that lyric again. You turned the screen over while I was reading. It felt different from just hearing the song.

day2_lunch_sea_25.text:
*Sea slowly winds the earbud cord around two fingers.*

Thanks for sharing the song. Now I'm curious about their other tracks.

day2_lunch_yuna_1.text: *Yuna is fiddling with her camera. A corner seat in the library. A bag of snacks sits beside her.*

day2_lunch_yuna_2.text: Sunbae! You came? Look at what I took today.

day2_lunch_yuna_3.text: *I flip through the photos. The hill behind school, the gym, a cat...*

day2_lunch_yuna_4.text: You take good photos. Where did you take this?

day2_lunch_yuna_5.text: Behind the gym. It's always in the same spot, so it's easy to find.

day2_lunch_yuna_6.text: You must have photographed it a lot.

day2_lunch_yuna_7.text: Yes. If I keep taking pictures, I can see what's changed. Look here.

day2_lunch_yuna_8.text:
*The cat's face is round on the screen.*

Even rounder up close. Did you wait for that shot?

day2_lunch_yuna_9.text: Do you take photos too, sunbae?

day2_lunch_yuna_10.text: No, just my phone camera. I don't take pictures very often.

day2_lunch_yuna_11.text: But you have a good eye. Yesterday you said the composition of the gym photo was good.

day2_lunch_yuna_12.text: The composition feels comfortable. I'd hesitate over where to crop, but your photos draw my eye right away. Is that because you take so many?

day2_lunch_yuna_13.text: If you miss it, you can't take it again.

day2_lunch_yuna_14.text:
*Yuna's finger stops on the screen.*

What? Aren't you showing me the next one?

day2_lunch_yuna_15.text: Sunbae... have you been to this school before?

day2_lunch_yuna_16.text: No? My first day was yesterday.

day2_lunch_yuna_18.text:
*Yuna smiles as she looks down at the camera. Her thumb stops on yesterday's gym photo rather than the one she was just showing me.*

Why did you stop on that photo? Are you comparing it with the one you showed me?

day2_lunch_yuna_19.text: Oh, it's nothing. I just remember seeing a similar photo.

day2_lunch_yuna_20.text:
*Small dates line up on Yuna's camera screen. Only the first photo has no timestamp.*

No time on this one. The others have it.

day2_lunch_yuna_21.text: If you're interested in the photography club, please stop by. I have a lot of photos to sort.

day2_lunch_yuna_23.text: Yes. No pressure. If we look together, you might notice things I missed.

day2_lunch_yuna_24.text:
*Yuna cups the camera in both hands. The strap folds and unfolds under her thumb.*

You're still gripping the camera, though. All right, I'll think about it. Thanks for not pushing.

day2_lunch_riin_1.text: There's no health record for you as a transfer student yet. Let me do a quick check.

day2_lunch_riin_2.text: Just blood pressure, eyesight, and weight, right?

day2_lunch_riin_3.text: Do you have any allergies? Food or medication.

day2_lunch_riin_6.text:
*She turns to the second page of the record and fills in the blanks beneath the blood pressure readings, one by one.*

That's a lot to write down. The checkup was quick.

day2_lunch_riin_8.text: *With her pen on the date field, Nurse Riin glances at me, then writes today’s date.*

day2_lunch_riin_9.text: Have you been dreaming a lot lately?

day2_lunch_riin_10.text: All of a sudden? I thought the examination was over and was already picking up my bag. Do dreams go in the health record too?

day2_lunch_riin_11.text: During your first week after transferring, we check sleep too. Some students get dazed during the day.

day2_lunch_riin_12.text: I did have a dream yesterday. When I woke up, though, my pillow was a little damp.

day2_lunch_riin_13.text: *Nurse Riin’s pen taps the paper once, then she finishes writing the date.*

day2_lunch_riin_14.text: If any scenes come back to you, tell me. I'll write them down.

day2_lunch_riin_16.text:
*The checkup is over and I'm about to leave when Nurse Riin takes out tea from a cabinet.*

The checkup's over, right? Getting up feels a little awkward. And you even got the tea out.

day2_lunch_riin_17.text: If you're not in a hurry, have a cup of tea before you go. Chamomile.

day2_lunch_riin_18.text:
*I sit on the infirmary sofa. Sunlight stretches through the gaps in the curtains. Nurse Riin sits opposite me.*

Is it okay to stay for tea? I only came for the checkup.

day2_lunch_riin_20.text: Better than I expected. Everyone's been nice.

day2_lunch_riin_24.text:
*Nurse Riin wraps both hands around her teacup and gazes out the window.*

If I say I'm fine, does the record end? I don't really know how used to this place I am. You can take your time with that.

day2_lunch_riin_25.text: That's what we usually write in the initial adjustment notes.

day2_lunch_riin_26.text: Has that happened to you too? Acting fine somewhere unfamiliar. I can't tell if I'm adjusting well or just keeping quiet.

day2_lunch_riin_27.text:
*Nurse Riin looks at me, then lowers her gaze to the teacup. She says nothing.*

Was that a strange question? You don't have to answer. I was just curious.

day2_lunch_riin_28.text: Finish your tea and head to class. You'll be late for the afternoon.

day2_lunch_riin_29.text:
*Another round stain appeared on the saucer. Nurse Riin looked only at that stain for a moment, then smiled.*

I've finished. I'll leave the cup here. There's another mark on the saucer… Shall I wipe it before I go?

day2_lunch_rooftop_1.text: *I'm climbing the stairs to the rooftop when I hear a voice from the landing.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_2.text: ...Yes, I submitted the approval. This time too, five days.

day2_lunch_rooftop_3.text: *I make a sound and the teacher hangs up.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_6.text: It's the start of the semester, so there's a lot of paperwork. Work from the education office.

day2_lunch_rooftop_7.text: *The teacher smiled as she walked past. Just before the phone screen went dark, all I saw was the call time: `00:00`.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_8.text: *I'm on the rooftop. The wind blows. No lunch box, but I unwrap a convenience store rice ball.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_9.text: *I can see the mountains beyond the school. My eyes seek out the bent cell in the wire mesh first.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_9a.text: *I lean against the railing and eat a rice ball. No one else is here. It's quiet.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10.text: *As I folded the samgak-gimbap wrapper, my eyes stopped on the expiration-date box with the number 5 printed in it. The words I'd just heard had cut off at the same number.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10a.text: *A student safety app notification popped up under the rooftop railing. `D-3 Submit Sports Day application`.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_10b.text: *I cleared the notification. The plastic wrapper crumpled softly in my hand.*

day2_lunch_rooftop_11.text: *The wind scatters my hair. When I close my eyes, someone laughs very close by. When I open them, only the samgak-gimbap plastic clings to the railing, trembling.*
